examples.ja: 津波が水田を押し流し、町は浸水しました。
examples.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.

examples.ja: ブースカ大好きの水田さんは、偶然入った店でめざとくブースカグッズを見つけて早速買うことにした。
examples.en: Ms. Mizuta likes that "Buska" character so much that last time she happened by a store that had Buska goods, she homed in on them and bought one on the spot.
